name: session-handoff
title: Session Handoff
summary: Create a portable handoff document that lets a fresh agent or colleague continue work with its state, decisions, next action, and references.

use_when: The user asks for a handoff, summary-for-continuation, or context transfer
The context window is nearly spent mid-work
Work moves to another harness, machine, directory, or person
avoid_when: Summarizing a finished change for review — use pr-body
Recording a durable architectural decision — use domain-modeling
The session is over and the lesson is environmental — use session-retro
